fix: Handle OTIO media_references as method in newer versions

In newer OpenTimelineIO versions, clip.media_references is a method
that must be called, not a property. This caused all clips to fail
filename extraction silently, resulting in 0 segments in analysis.

Also replaced Unicode box-drawing characters with ASCII equivalents
to avoid Windows console encoding errors.
